subject: Security re-attest schedule, term amendment & capacity handoff
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Park <elaine@novus.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 16 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Security re-attest: proposed timeline + capacity uplift

Hi Elaine,

Thanks again for confirming Novus will move forward with the upcoming SOC 2 re-attestation. To keep the renewal and capacity uplift aligned, proposed plan below:

1) Evidence handoff window: Dec 22 - Dec 24 (bulk S3 transfer or secure Drive share)
2) Operational cutover for the extra dedicated capacity (+2 GPU nodes): Jan 5, 2027
3) Term amendment: 12 -> 18 months for the renewal period (we can reflect the discount in the amendment)

Please review and confirm the handoff method (S3 vs Drive) and whether procurement needs a PO before we send the amendment. I attached an evidence matrix template to speed the handoff.

Next steps if you agree:
- I’ll draft the contract amendment and share for signature (DocuSign)
- Our ops team will schedule the data transfer and pre-provision the extra capacity
- We’ll provide a short checklist for the SOC2 artifacts we typically need (logs, retention policy summary, user access lists)

Attachments: [Attachment: evidence-matrix-template.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0182

--
Redwood Inference | Simplifying production LLM inference
From: Elaine Park <elaine@novus.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@novus.com, security@novus.com
Date: Thu, 17 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Security re-attest: proposed timeline + capacity uplift

Marissa —

Appreciate the clear plan. A few clarifying questions before we lock dates:

- Retention horizon: Novus requires a 18-month retention window for audit logs. Can Redwood confirm the export will include full, unredacted audit logs for that period?
- Evidence format: S3 transfer is preferred, but we need a presigned URL method and confirmation of encryption at rest/in transit.
- Procurement: I’ve looped in procurement@novus.com — PO process typically takes 5 business days. We will aim to have the PO in place before DocuSign.

If those are okay, Dec 22 works for an initial bulk export.

Thanks —
Elaine Park
Director, Security & Privacy | Novus Financial
elaine@novus.com

Hi Elaine / Proc Team —

Thanks for the quick response. Short answers:

- Retention/Logs: We can provide the raw audit log export covering the last 18 months. We’ll include a manifest and MD5 checksums. For sensitive fields we’ll provide guidance but do not plan to redact logs unless you request a scoped export.
- Transfer method: S3 presigned POST preferred. Redwood will encrypt at rest (AES-256) and enforce TLS in transit. We’ll send the presigned endpoints and one-time credentials the morning of Dec 22.
- Procurement: understood — let us know when PO is routed; we’ll hold the DocuSign link until you confirm.

I’ve attached a draft amendment reflecting: 18-month retention assurance, +2 dedicated nodes (billed pro rata from Jan 5), and an 8% term discount for an 18-month committed renewal. If that sounds good I’ll send the DocuSign.

Attachments: [Attachment: novus-amendment-draft-v1.pdf (application/pdf)]

Best,
Marissa
